text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah......!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Ah...! ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A gentle, tranquil, soft breeze... yet one 
that gives such a powerful push to your 
back.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That wind blew past alongside her. As if 
trying to guide me forward—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Flower-san... please tell me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: What are you thinking right now?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah... um.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wanted you to find courage through 
Zephyr-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Courage...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—I have a dream. I wonder if I can shape 
the future of someone precious to me... 
through my running.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Through running... the future.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I work super hard and achieve great 
things, I know I'll be able to help that 
person.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Still, in order to do that... I have to 
overcome this wall."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm still doing my best right now. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because that person gave me courage, I was 
able to run even better than before!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If Zephyr-san saw me like that... do you 
think it would make her feel like giving 
it her all?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's what I was thinking, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Waah.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I say it out loud... I'm saying 
something pretty outrageous, aren't I?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Is that so? It was clear as day to me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I already knew it out on the turf. Your 
kindness, your strength... that sweet 
fragrance of yours.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind felt especially wonderful today. 
So much so that I just wanted to drift 
wherever it carried me...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Flower-san. I...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
2000m... I shall become the ultimate wind 
and blow right through it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Before that, however... I will repay you 
for giving me courage.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: In the very way you did it for me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes... I shall deliver 
the wind to you."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to the wind... that will 
carve out that future.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san seems to have cheered up a 
little bit... I'm so glad.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That she'll do her best next time too—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I-I went ahead and answered for 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"You entered me in the Sprinters Stakes?! 
Even though I hadn't talked to Trainer 
yet...!"
choice_data_list: That was the plan, so it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then...!

The stage where she shines brightest. In 
that place where she delivered an amazing 
performance last year, I wanted the 
"current" her to seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
By the way, will you not be taking on 
Medium distance races?
choice_data_list: I guess it depends on the adjustments.

text_block_list.text:
Soon after, there is the western Grand 
Prix race, the Takarazuka Kinen. Depending 
on her condition, it might be worth 
considering.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Then, I will give the Sprinters Stakes 
everything I've got!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...In last year's Sprinters Stakes, you 
guided me through when I had lost my way, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I put all my trust in you, Trainer, and 
because of that, I was able to run a great 
race.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I can run even better than that, if I 
can become number one...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's do our best in the 
Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll give "number one" to you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Welcome, Cosmos-san♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The flowers here have really blossomed 
lively too, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...All right, I'll do my best...!
